protocol_version.description: Protocol version. Consumer: tools/validate.py (rejects a mismatched major version with a pointer to docs/MIGRATIONS.md).

id.description: Consumer: every queue script (filename↔id, lock filename, event refs), project-notion.py row key.

project_id.description: Consumer: all path resolution, project-notion.py grouping.

owner_agent.description: An agent id or the literal "unassigned". Consumer: lease-task.py first-lease eligibility, projection.

state.description: Consumer: every queue script's state-machine guard, expire-leases.py, projection.

priority.description: 1=highest. Consumer: a leasing agent choosing next work; human triage.

lease.description: Optional; present iff state is "leased" or "in-progress" (business rule — not enforceable in JSON Schema alone). Consumer: lease-task.py / expire-leases.py / complete-task.py.

inputs.description: May be empty. Pointers only, never embedded data. Consumer: the executing agent fetches inputs.

label.description: Consumer: the executing agent fetches inputs.

ref.description: Consumer: the executing agent fetches inputs.

kind.description: Consumer: the executing agent fetches inputs.

acceptance_criteria.description: Consumer: the executing agent + complete-task.py (each confirmed before done).

evidence.description: Optional, but must be non-empty before state can be "done" (business rule — not enforceable in JSON Schema alone). Consumer: complete-task.py ("evidence before done") + human reviewer.

label.description: Consumer: complete-task.py ("evidence before done") + human reviewer.

ref.description: Consumer: complete-task.py ("evidence before done") + human reviewer.

blocked_reason.description: Optional; required in practice iff state=="blocked" (business rule — not enforceable in JSON Schema alone). Consumer: human triage, projection.

history_ref.description: Pointer to the event log filtered by this id. Consumer: OPERATIONS.md human audit.
